title: 第5章 杀个人卖个猪赚点钱第6章 三十年修炼路送走多少师兄弟
content_zh:
“师弟，师兄来了。”
“许师弟，你在吗？”
清早，一道响亮的声音回荡在灵药峰上。
声音浑厚，并且响亮。
一个魁梧大汉出现在许君白面前，许君白行礼：“见过宋师兄。”
花石峰宋真罗宋师兄，乃是天才弟子之一。
白梧山少有的天才，可不是许君白能比的。
“许师弟，说吧，你找师兄所为何事？”
许君白拱手道：“宋师兄，事情是这样的，昨夜，有两个小蟊贼闯入灵药峰，想要偷取师弟种植的灵药，师弟我……”
故事嘛，随便胡扯一通。
而宋真罗盯着许君白一脸无语，摆摆手：“许师弟，这个版本我听了不下十次了，说吧，你想我怎么做？”
许君白笑着拿出十几块灵石递给师兄，都是两位死去的大冤种留下的好东西，还有两瓶丹药，以及一些功法，除了丹药，许君白都递给了宋师兄。
“师兄，拿着，战利品。”
宋真罗师兄不想要的，这些东西拿着烫手啊。
拿了，可是要负责的。
“许师弟，你这样子师兄压力很大的。”
“师兄，帮帮忙。”
宋真罗看着许君白那张笑脸，俗话说，伸手不打笑脸人，师弟都这么懂事了，他呢，也不能不帮忙。
“哎，师弟，这一次就算了，莫要再有下一次了，师兄我压力也很大的，你这些年的锅我都背了，多少是卧底，多少是内奸，你我心知肚明。”
“上面的人也都清楚，真的不要再有下一次了，师兄我扛不住的。”

许君白笑着拍拍宋师兄的手，感谢道：“师兄，谢了。”
“行了，不要给我废话了，算师兄拜托你了，真的不要再有下一次了。”
“明白，明白。”
宋真罗叹息一声，也不奢望许君白会收手。
那些人，都该死，明知道灵药峰乃是那些大佬的地盘，许君白不过是替他们种田的，那些人呢，非要不长眼，明知道危险，还要闯进来，这不是找死吗？
自寻死路的人很多，总有一些不长眼的，认为可以拿下灵药峰，也不看看人家后台是谁。
死了也是白死。
再说了，许君白很懂得做人，人情世故方面，安排得十分周到。
路子走通了，也就没人找他的麻烦。
没人愿意为了一个死人和灵石过不去。
“许师弟，下一次，能不杀人尽量不要杀人。”
“师兄，我会的。”
许君白摊开手，也不是他杀的，他也想留下活口，可是做不到啊。
回头，白了一眼肩膀上的蝴蝶。
又看了看房子背后的那只猪，硕大的公猪在猪圈里面，十分明显。
其他的猪，可都是值钱的好东西，许君白走到了猪圈门口。
“也到了杀猪的时候。”
硕大的猪顿时不肯了，走到了许君白面前，露出那双人性化的眼眸，很是愤怒，那些猪都是它的后代，岂能够杀了。
“知道了，到时候分你一份，行了吧。”
“呃呃。”

“不满意？喂喂，你不要太贪心了，给你三成，不能再多了。”
“呃呃呃。”
“什么，这些都是你的孩子，得加钱？你可真是他们的好父亲。”
身后那些猪儿还不知道自己面临什么下场，还在那里吃东西。
content_en:
"Junior brother, senior brother is here."
"Junior Brother Xu, are you there?"
Early in the morning, a loud voice echoed on the Spiritual Medicine Peak.
The sound is rich and loud.
A burly man appeared in front of Xu Junbai. Xu Junbai saluted: "I have met Senior Brother Song."
Senior Brother Song Zhenluosong of Huashifeng is one of the genius disciples.
Bai Wushan's rare genius is not comparable to Xu Junbai's.
"Junior Brother Xu, tell me, why are you looking for Senior Brother?"
Xu Junbai cupped his hands and said, "Senior Brother Song, here's what happened. Last night, two little frog thieves broke into the elixir peak and wanted to steal the elixir grown by junior brother. Junior brother, I..."
It's a story, just some random nonsense.
Song Zhenluo stared at Xu Junbai with a speechless expression and waved his hand: "Junior Brother Xu, I have listened to this version no less than ten times. Tell me, what do you want me to do?"
Xu Junbai smiled and took out more than a dozen spiritual stones and handed them to his senior brother. They were all good things left by the two dead enemies. There were also two bottles of elixirs and some exercises. Except for the elixirs, Xu Junbai handed them all to senior brother Song.
"Brother, take the trophy."
Senior Brother Song Zhenluo doesn’t want these things, they are hot to hold.
Take it, but you have to be responsible.
"Junior Brother Xu, senior brother is under a lot of pressure when you are like this."
"Brother, please help me."
Song Zhenluo looked at Xu Junbai's smiling face. As the saying goes, if you reach out and don't hit the smiling person, your junior brother is so sensible, so he has to help.
"Hey, junior brother, forget it this time. Don't let it happen again. Senior brother, I am also under a lot of pressure. I have taken the blame for you all these years. How many are undercovers and how many are traitors? You and I know it well."
"The people above also know that we really don't want this to happen again. Senior brother, I can't handle it."
Xu Junbai smiled and patted Senior Brother Song's hand, thanking him: "Senior Brother, thank you."
"Okay, don't talk nonsense to me. I'm begging you, senior brother. I really don't want this to happen again."
"I understand, I understand."
Song Zhenluo sighed, not expecting Xu Junbai to stop.
Those people deserve to die. They know clearly that Spiritual Medicine Peak is the territory of those big bosses, and Xu Junbai is just farming for them. But those people must be blind and know the danger and still break in. Isn't this looking for death?
There are many people who are looking for death, and there are always some short-sighted people who think they can win the elixir peak without even looking at who is behind them.
Even if you die, you will die in vain.
Besides, Xu Junbai knows how to be a good person and has very thoughtful arrangements for people and sophistication.
Now that the road is open, no one will cause trouble for him.
No one wants to live with a dead person and a spiritual stone.
"Junior Brother Xu, next time, try not to kill anyone if you can."
"Brother, I can do it."
Xu Junbai spread his hands, it was not him who killed him, he also wanted to leave him alive, but he couldn't.
Turning back, he rolled his eyes at the butterfly on his shoulder.
I looked at the pig behind the house again. The huge boar was very obvious in the pig pen.
The other pigs are all valuable things. Xu Junbai walked to the door of the pig pen.
"It's time to kill the pig."
The huge pig immediately refused and walked up to Xu Junbai, showing his human eyes, very angry. Those pigs were all his descendants, how could he kill them.
"I know, I'll give you a share when the time comes, okay."
"Uh-huh."
"Not satisfied? Hey, don't be too greedy. I'll give you 30%, no more."
"Uh-huh."
"What, these are your children, need more money? You are such a good father to them."
The pigs behind him didn't know what would happen to them, and they were still eating.
